purpose: Fail-closed quality contract for AI-agent, ML/NLP, and Automission outputs.
principles: independent verification remains distinct from preparation
no silent fallback or hidden mutation
every promoted result must be reproducible

metrics.accuracy: measured only against a declared evaluator and test set
metrics.precision: measured per task, not inferred from workflow success
metrics.recall: measured per task, not inferred from workflow success
metrics.hallucination_rate: must be measured on a labeled evaluation set
metrics.automation_health: operational metric only; never treated as factual accuracy
